derivation: from a compound of G1722 (ἐν) and G2372 (θυμός);

occurrences.text: But while he thought on these things, behold, the angel of the Lord appeared unto him in a dream, saying, Joseph, thou son of David, fear not to take unto thee Mary thy wife: for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Ghost.
And Jesus knowing their thoughts said, Wherefore think ye evil in your hearts?
While Peter thought on the vision, the Spirit said unto him, Behold, three men seek thee.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
